title: Unit Event — Our Happy Ending — Episode8 A Final Farewell

meta.Event Outline: Following the successful 30th Anniversary Show, the Wonderlands×Showtime cast feel renewed determination for their respective dreams. Emu, realizing that the troupe will part ways sooner or later, attempts to put on a brave face and say goodbye with a smile. Meanwhile, Rui makes a bold proposition to the Otori brothers.

rows.Line: Two months later
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Are we all ready?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm all set!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ready whenever.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Then, Emu, take it away!
Give us an extra dose of energy this time!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's go out there and do our best! Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Rui, Nene & Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!!!

rows.Speaker: Alchemist
rows.Line:
“At last, it is complete.
A robot that can sing in place of our songstress.”
song00006_off_f

rows.Speaker: Alchemist
rows.Line: “And here we have a mechanical dragon.”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader, Clown & Songstress
rows.Line: “Whoa!”

rows.Speaker: Songstress
rows.Line:
“Wh-What do I do...?!
I can't control the robot...!”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “What the—?!”

rows.Speaker: Alchemist
rows.Line:
“Your dream of becoming a star...
You simply wish to be seen as one by others, no? To be showered with praise...”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line:
“It's true that it's my dream to become a star.
A star who brings joy to everyone!”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “To me, a star is someone who delights the audience as much as his fellow performers with the most wonderful shows!”

rows.Speaker: Clown
rows.Line: “I figured out what my dream is.”

rows.Speaker: Clown
rows.Line: “My dream is to fill the village where we met with smiles and laughter.”

rows.Speaker: Clown
rows.Line: “So, for now, I guess this is...”
“Not so fast!”

rows.Speaker: Clown
rows.Line: “Huh?”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Huh?
Something's different.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Yes, could it be...?
Did they change the ending like we did for our performance?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Cool☆
What do you think their ending's gonna be like?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I'm looking forward to seeing what they came up with. In any case, I'm sure it'll be...>
“Honestly, why is it that none of you thought to discuss this matter with me, the village elder's daughter...?”

rows.Speaker: Village Elder's Daughter
rows.Line: “What you've all done has without question made this village a much happier place compared to before.”

rows.Speaker: Village Elder's Daughter
rows.Line: “However, I also believe that we'll have no trouble maintaining the joy you've bestowed upon us.”

rows.Speaker: Village Elder's Daughter
rows.Line: “On top of that, I'm sure seeing what the world outside of here has to offer will only be to your benefit.”

rows.Speaker: Village Elder's Daughter
rows.Line: “So, all of you should go! Together!”

rows.Speaker: Village Elder's Daughter
rows.Line: “And bring that same joy to everyone around the world!”

rows.Speaker: Clown
rows.Line:
“Okay...!
Thank you!!!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Wow, could things have ended on a happier note?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Hehe♪
I really love this ending☆>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Me too.
Everyone seems overcome with joy.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, I'm glad they went with this version...!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Me too! And they have such big smiles on their faces!>

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: “And so...”

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: “They made shows together while pursuing their dreams forever after.”

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: “The end!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Grandpa, that was so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I didn't know shows could be this much fun! The story was really exciting, and everyone's smiling from ear to ear...!

rows.Speaker: Grandfather
rows.Line:
Hehe. See what I mean?
I'm so glad we could come today.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Hehe. You're smiling too, Grandpa!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Everyone has such big smiles on their faces...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (The way they're sparkling's so beautiful...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(After Grandpa passed away...
Everyone stopped coming to the Wonder Stage.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But now...)

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Remember when the dragon roared?! That was so cool!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: I know, right?! I wanna see that again! Just one more time!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I wanna fill this park with even more smiles...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm gonna go out into the world with everyone, learn as much as I can, come back here and put smiles on the faces of all our visitors.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (And someday... I'm gonna make everyone around the world smile from ear to ear!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We greatly appreciate you all joining us today, and for all the support you've given us until now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: From the bottom of our hearts, thank you very much!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene, Emu & Rui
rows.Line: Thank you very much!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, that's it. Our final showing's over...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Even after they found out we'll be leaving soon, our visitors were willing to give us a nice send-off... That made me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
I wasn't expecting to receive so many well-wishes.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! Oh, that reminds me!
Sakurako said, “Make the most of this opportunity like your lives depend on it!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, right. She probably had to go back to her own show.
It's amazing how she was there for us right up until the end.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not only that, our friends from the other stages, including the Phoenix Stage, agreed to put on shows here in our stead. We'll need to thank them again when we get the chance...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone!
Your final performance was so wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Sis! Keisuke! Shosuke!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This day wouldn't have been possible without your help. Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Still, things aren't going to feel quite the same after you've all left the park...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Hehe. Are you sure you're okay?
We know you're a bit of a crybaby.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Hey, do you really need to mention that now?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Now, more importantly...
We have a farewell gift for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A farewell gift?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Yes.
Remember what we said about getting ourselves introduced to the world of show business?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: During our travels, we met all sorts of actors and directors. So, I decided to reach out to some of them to see if there are any troupes or companies out there that'd be willing to help you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! You did...?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Yes.
Three names came up, and they all differ drastically from one another. I'm sure you'll learn a lot from them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You went to all that trouble just for us...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Well, I'm only going to tell you how to get in touch with them. It'll be on you to actually contact them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I... I need to thank you as well!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: It was nothing. There's no need to thank me.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I mean, I also want to see what happens after you've been given a chance to really grow.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Shosuke!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Now...
Before we leave, I believe it's time for us to make our special salute.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do that.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: A special salute?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
We'd like to take this opportunity to say goodbye to our most valued companion.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, Tsukasa, take it away!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is our final salute... To the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You were the reason we were able to have as much fun as we did!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for all that you've given us until now!!!
song00006_off_f

rows.Speaker: Rui, Emu & Nene
rows.Line: Thank you!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (The Wonder Stage spent this entire time watching over us as we pursued our dreams...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Grandpa's dream, my dream and everyone else's dreams...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Thank you from the bottom of my heart.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I promise to come back after I've learned how to fill this park with even more smiles. So...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll see you again!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Allriiight!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's time for the curtain to rise on the next chapter of Wonderlands×Showtime's epic tale!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Didn't you say something like this before...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm looking forward to seeing how this next chapter turns out.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't know what's gonna happen...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I'm really excited...! And feel super wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I as well!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So! Let's take these feelings and get ready to weigh anchor!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Here we go, you guys!
We're setting sail for our dreams! Won-won...

rows.Speaker: Emu, Tsukasa, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Tsukasa, Nene & Rui
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hahaha!
Hehe...
